text:
lia: Quick ask from partner call this morning 7:45 PT7 : they want a 'mini-commit' private offer (3mo) that gives higher early discounts for usage growth but explicitly excludes appliance/hardware credits from stacking. Can we do that on marketplace?

sam: Yep technically doable. We should use separate SKUs and gating rules. Keep the private offer SKU mapped to committed usage only, and make HW credits redeemable via a distinct line-item that requires separate redemption flow.

caroline: Ops note : for marketplace we can map commit SKU -> billing code and add a boolean "non_stackable": true to the offer metadata so downstream ledger doesn't apply both discounts.

own: Sales POV: also want a co-announcement window with partner marketing. We need to decide if the private offer goes live on the public listing or is sent as a private marketplace link. Partner prefers a visible tile to drive inbound. Thoughts? :loudspeaker:

legal: Private offers are fine. Must include a line: "Hardware/appliance credits do not combine with private-offer commit discounts; redemption is separate." Propose 90-day redemption window for HW credits. Also, no implied refunds if discounts change mid-term.

lia: Proposed cadence from partner: 3mo term, early fast ramp discount to incentivize conversion from trial. Example tier idea:
```
mini_commit_v1:
  term_months: 3
  tiers:
    0-100k_tokens: 12% off
    100k-500k_tokens: 18% off
    500k+: 25% off
  early_conversion_bonus: 5% if convert from marketplace trial within 30 days
hardware_credit:
  sku: PARTNER-HW-90
  redemption_window_days: 90
  stackable_with_commit: false
```

glen-sales: That early conversion bonus is gold. Add a seller credit for closing within 14 days to increase urgency. We should track MQL -> PO conversion rate for this bundle.

finance-bot: FYI: any early-conversion bonus needs to be tracked as contra-revenue events. We'll need a GL mapping and a flag on the invoice. Ping @finance for GL mapping request.

partner-bot: Private offer draft (preview): https://partners.redwood.ai/offers/draft/mini-commit-2026 (expires in 7 days). Webhook for commit attainment: https://hooks.redwood.ai/partner/mini-commit/attainment. Sample payload includes daily_cumulative, term_total, and trigger_flags.

caroline: Ops follow-up: we'll need a reconciliation CSV for partner SI with per-customer daily deltas. Can generate at 02:00 UTC. Also propose an opt-in renewal nudge if customer > 85% commit by month 3.

own: For co-announce: marketing wants a 2-week embargo before public tile + partner joint blog. If partner insists on visible tile day-1, we need a pre-approved quote doc for field sales.

legal: Add an explicit non-marketing claim: "Offer terms valid for listed customers only; resale to third parties prohibited." I'll add both clauses to the draft.

glen-sales: Action items: ops to deliver webhook sample + CSV template; legal to post updated draft by Wed; finance to provide GL mapping by Fri; sales to get pre-approved quote template. We'll run a partner dry-run next Tue. :checkered_flag:
